title: tshark: Custom fields for -e based on field expressions
description:
Allow the `-e` option to tshark to specify any expression which
is valid in the display filter language, and use that to produce
output similar to the columns.

Fix #10573, #18499

changes_data.diff:
@@ -31,6 +31,9 @@ Custom columns can be defined using any valid field expression, such as
 display filter functions, slices, arithmetic calculations, logical tests,
 raw byte addressing, and the layer modifier.
 
+Custom output fields for `tshark -e` can also be defined using any
+valid field expression.
+
 Many other improvements have been made.
 See the “New and Updated Features” section below for more details.
 
@@ -140,6 +143,14 @@ The following features are new (or have been significantly updated) since versio
      resolution or value string lookup) are not supported for any of the new
      expressions yet.
 
+* Custom output fields for `tshark -e <field>` can also be defined using any
+  valid field expression as above.
+
+  ** For custom output fields, `X or Y` is the usual logical test; to output
+     multiple fields use multiple `-e` terms as before.
+
+  ** The various `-E` options, including `-E occurrence`, all work as expected.
+
 * When selecting "Manage Interfaces" from "Capture Options", Wireshark only
